channel.title: AMNI-SCIENT Updates
channel.description: What shipped, what it means, why it matters.

item.title: Amni OS 0.4.4 ISO
item.description: Arch plus Plasma 6 with a Start menu, Steam, Wine, and Amni-Browse. 5.9 GB image, Windows stays in GRUB.

item.title: Research pages say what the proofs say
item.description: I went through all eight research pages and labeled measured results, design choices, and work that does not exist yet. Math actually renders.

item.title: Amni v2 plays in the browser
item.description: The remake is live at /game/v2/. Thirteen realms, WebGPU, gamepad, saves stay on this device.

item.title: Amni-Browse on the phone and on Windows
item.description: Signed Android APK, private by default, and a 6 MB Windows zip with our chrome on WebView2. Zero telemetry on both.

item.title: Amni-Connect installers for Windows and Linux
item.description: Windows Setup, AppImage, .deb, and .rpm on the product page. Host on the machine, view from any browser, nothing in the cloud.

item.title: HedgeDoc on Android
item.description: Unofficial native client for HedgeDoc 1.x and 2. Sideload the APK, point it at the server you already run.

item.title: A swipe keyboard that stays on the phone
item.description: Swipe, next-word, and corrections run on the device. The 286,000-word list and whatever it learns from you never leave.

item.title: Grok Remote on Windows is a real app
item.description: The PC side is a Tauri desktop now, GrokRemote.exe. Phones still pair with one QR.

item.title: Grok Remote is easier to live with
item.description: Desktop can see every chat again, long-press reacts without a stuck bar, and cancelling a queued message puts the text back in the box.

item.title: Updates now live on amni-scient.com
item.description: A dated ship log when something you can actually use lands.

item.title: All eight Braid seats are live
item.description: ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor, and OpenCode join Claude, Grok, Gemini, and a local seat at the table. Braid still drives the subscriptions you already pay for.
